name: Jerijador
description: Jerijador, located in the Calaron sector of the Outer Rim Territories, was a planet teeming with a variety of lifeforms that was hospitable to humanoids. In the aftermath of the Battle of Yavin, a fleet of Imperial warships led by Moff Vensell staged at Jerijador in preparation for an assault on the Rebel Alliance. This attracted many scavengers who came to salvage the junk that the departing Imperial vessels left behind upon entering hyperspace.
